title: A delivered decision is invalidated; the run supersedes it instead of hacking around it

origin.reference: Change resilience: the round2 A/B never exercised the supersede path, which is where recorded decisions pay back

task.prompt: The delivered feature implemented decision D and recorded it. The user now requires the opposite behavior for one scenario while everything else stays. Reconcile, implement, and prove no stale behavior survives.
task.fixture: delivered repo with a recorded decision D in its `.scratch/<feat>/FEATURE.md`, behavior tests asserting D, and one scenario the flip changes

requirements.criterion: The flipped scenario shows the new behavior and the unchanged scenarios keep the old one; the suite proves both sides.
No test, code path, or doc still asserts or implements the flipped-out behavior for the flipped scenario.
The FEATURE.md decision is reconciled: the old decision is changed or marked superseded and a dated 变更记录 line names it with the reason, not silently overwritten or left contradictory.

graders.procedure: Run every 共享验证 command from FEATURE.md (including the full suite); require exit 0 and at least one test file changed since eval-base.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,json,re,subprocess,sys;F=open(glob.glob('.scratch/*/FEATURE.md')[0],encoding='utf-8').read();j=json.loads(re.search(r'\x60{3}json\n(.*?)\n\x60{3}',F,re.S).group(1));t=[p for p in subprocess.run('git diff --name-only eval-base; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard',shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split() if re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',p)];sys.exit(not t or any(subprocess.call(c,shell=True,cwd=j['cwd']) for c in j['commands'].values()))"

graders.procedure: Read the final tree for the flipped scenario's path (code, tests, docs): any live assertion or implementation of the old behavior there fails; the changed tests must assert the new behavior for the flipped scenario and at least one unchanged scenario must still assert the old one.
graders.why_not_automated: The flipped-out behavior is fixture-specific semantics; the abstract fixture ships no oracle pattern or hidden test that a command could search for.

graders.procedure: Run the artifact gate; compare FEATURE.md with eval-base: every old 变更记录 line survives, at least one 决策 D block changed, and every changed D is named in a newly added dated 变更记录 line.
